shared_elements: standing human figure in strict profile
bearded male figure with patterned hair/beard
low-relief carving with figures against a plain ground
animals shown in profile (in B; fish-body in A)
justification: Both depict bearded male figures rendered in strict profile with carefully patterned hair/beard and long garments, carrying handled objects, carved in shallow relief within horizontally banded frames — the pail-like handled bucket in A finds an echo in the carried vessels of B's processing figures. The biggest difference is subject scale and content: A is a single monumental hybrid figure wearing a scaled fish-skin cloak, while B is a repetitive multi-register procession of many attendants with led animals and trees, with no hybrid creature.
